literal_meaning: ভুল কথা বলা (wrong or mistaken speaking)
figurative_meaning_en: Delirious or incoherent talk, like a madman's ravings
example_sentences_in_bangla: জ্বরের কারণে সে রাতভর ভুল বকতে থাকল।
এসব ভুল বকা বন্ধ করো, সিরিয়াসলি কথা বলো।
example_sentences_in_english: Due to the fever, he kept talking nonsense all night.
Stop spouting this gibberish and speak seriously.
note: Commonly used to describe someone speaking incoherently due to illness or confusion in Bengali culture.
